description: New .se and .nu domains on a date. Returns a list of records; pass next_cursor to get the next page. Fields: date (date): Day the change was seen (Europe/Stockholm); domain (varchar); tld (varchar); nameservers (varchar[]): Name servers after the change (empty when removed); has_ds (boolean); serial (bigint): Serial the change was seen in; detected_at (timestamptz).
